caption: The video captures a close-up view of a person in a green sleeve and dark vest using a cordless drill on a light-colored wooden frame. The structure includes straight outer rails, an inner cross rail, and a curved top member, with visible holes and fastener points along the wood. In the first portion, the drill is held roughly horizontal with its bit pressed against a hole on the right side of the inner cross rail, the operator's hand steadying the tool while the angle shifts slightly. The drill is then lifted away from that rail, the bit swinging toward the upper side as the tool is repositioned leftward. It rotates into a more vertical orientation as both hands adjust around the body. The bit is brought into contact with a fastener location on the left side of the inner rail, where it is held upright with small positional adjustments. Throughout the excerpt the wooden frame itself remains largely in place.
